lines.text: By wisdom a house is built, and through knowledge its rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure.
A wise man is strong, and victory lies in a multitude of counselors when war is waged with sound guidance.
Rescue those being led away to death, because the One who weighs hearts will repay a man according to his deeds.
A righteous man may fall twelve times and still get up, but the wicked stumble in bad times.
Fear the LORD and the Pharaoh, and do not associate with the rebellious, who will bring sudden destruction.
